description:
The profile arms run their own error classifier and render findings through separate JSON and human exits. This moves the profile group to library handlers.

## Background

In `crates/jit/src/main.rs`, `ProfileCommands::{List, Show, Validate, Diff, Apply, Reconfigure, Capture, Pack, Add, Upgrade}` go through `run_profile_apply`, `render_profile_difference` and `profile_result` in `main.rs`, which call `profile_json_error` (`crates/jit/src/output/failure.rs`). Its downcast cascade reports any `NotFoundError` as `PROFILE_NOT_FOUND` and every other repository-state or unknown error as `PROFILE_ERROR`, unlike the classifier. `profile diff` with conflicts and the agreement check with divergence exit `VALIDATION_FAILED` through separate JSON and human paths. A missing profile has a typed error the classifier maps to `PROFILE_NOT_FOUND`.

A handler in `crates/jit/src/dispatch/` takes its parsed arguments and a `CommandContext` (the executor and the `OutputMode { json, quiet }`) and returns `anyhow::Result<Outcome<R>>`; one registration per group generates the group's dispatch and its schema response lookup. Success responses are types defined in the output module (`crates/jit/src/output/`) or output constructors wrapping a command-layer result, each deriving `JsonSchema` and a human rendering; list payloads are `ListEnvelope<K, T, E>` instantiations; failures are returned as errors that `jit::output::failure::classify` maps to one code and exit status; a non-zero findings result is `Outcome`'s findings variant, rendered under `--json` as the failure envelope with the report in `error.details` and its registered code as the exit status.

On main, `run()` in `crates/jit/src/main.rs` parses the arguments and calls `dispatch()` in `main.rs`, which holds the command match; the arms and inline code this issue places in `run()` live in `dispatch()`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `run()` dispatches every `profile` leaf to a handler in `crates/jit/src/dispatch/profile.rs`, and `main.rs` keeps none of `run_profile_lifecycle`, `render_profile_difference`, `profile_result` or `profile_json_error`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each leaf returns its registered response type, profile leaves register their `ProfileCollection` responses, and the schema names a typed response for each leaf.
- [hard] REQ-03: `profile diff` conflicts return a findings outcome with `VALIDATION_FAILED`.
- [hard] REQ-04: Failures are classified errors with no substituted code; a missing profile reports the code `classify` assigns `ProfileNotFoundError`, and a test asserts that a repository-state failure reports its classified code instead of `PROFILE_ERROR`.
- [hard] REQ-05: Where a leaf's exit codes change, its rows in `CommandSchema::generate_command_exit_codes` (`crates/jit/src/schema.rs`) state the new codes and `docs/reference/exit-codes.md` is regenerated.
- [hard] REQ-06: Human output, success payloads and exit codes of these leaves are otherwise unchanged, and the existing suites pass without weakened assertions.

## Notes

Design rationale: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/plan.md`; inventories with function and arm citations: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/investigation.md`.
title: Profile commands move to library handlers
